# CLI reference

All commands use exit code `0` for success, `1` for validation or operational failure, and `2` for command-line usage errors.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `getdone` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-check-updates` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-init` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-install-adapter` | Installed console entry point |

| `getdone-search` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-select-context` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-validate-overlay` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-validate-project` | Installed console entry point |
| `getdone-validate-records` | Installed console entry point |
